transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... folks keep saying I’ve been doing too much. I don’t really see it that way. I’m just trying to get the move handled, make sure the new garage is built right, keep things organized at church, and still show the younger guys at work how the job’s supposed to be done. Feels like I’m the only one with enough drive to keep it all moving.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest or not getting pleasure from things that usually make you happy, like hobbies, time with family, or church activities?
I don’t know... I wouldn’t say that. I still care about those things. Maybe I’m just busier than usual, that’s all.
Have you noticed feeling more tired or having less energy lately, even if you’re doing the same amount of work or activities as before?
Not really. I mean, I get tired like anybody my age, but I wouldn’t say it’s been a problem or anything.
Have you felt unusually confident or like you can take on more than usual, maybe even more than others think you should?

Yeah... maybe. I’ve been feeling pretty sure I know what needs doing, and people ought to either help or stay out of the way. I can be in a good mood, joking around, feeling like I can handle anything... then if my wife or my boy questions some little thing, I snap. I don’t like that, but it happens.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep lately, like feeling rested after only a few hours of sleep or not feeling tired even if you haven’t slept much?
I don’t know... I haven’t really kept track of it. I sleep when I sleep. I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed needing a lot less, no.

Have you had a period of time lasting at least one week where your mood was noticeably elevated, you felt unusually energetic, or you were more irritable than usual, along with taking on more tasks or activities than usual?

Yeah… I guess so. I’ve had stretches where I feel like people need to get on board with what I’m doing or just stay out of my way. I’ll be joking around, feeling pretty big, like I’ve got it all handled… then my wife or my boy asks one little question and I snap.
Can you think of a time recently where your mood was especially high or you felt unusually good, maybe even like you were on top of the world, and this lasted for several days in a row?

Yeah… I mean, not “on top of the world” exactly, but I’ve had days where I’m joking around, feeling bigger than usual, like I know what needs doing and everybody else needs to get with it or move aside. Then somebody asks me something small—my wife or my boy—and I just snap.
